what_happened: Dispatch attributed the eighth upward edge's arrival to commit ba6c0f5dd (task 788 phase 6). Re-verification via git log --follow -p on AxiomDischarge.lean showed the import line and its first usage actually landed 11 minutes earlier in commit 078e6109fe (task 788 phase 5, same day 2026-10-14); ba6c0f5dd only added a second usage of an import already present. Corrected in the research report's Decisions section; does not change the fix or acceptance criteria.

Dispatch's acceptance text cites 47 PASSes from check-module-invariants.sh --no-build; actual re-run shows 46 PASS lines plus one INFO C36b skipped (--no-build) line. Reconciled: C36b is lake-build-dependent and would be the 47th PASS under a full build. Substantive acceptance condition (exit 0, ALL CHECKS PASSED) holds either way and is unaffected by this task's in-scope files.

Research report's 'Exact Edit Sites' enumeration omitted two live count statements that a broader grep -nE 'seven|\b7\b|7-line|7 line' sweep over the same four files surfaced: scripts/check-metalogic-cycles.sh:7 (assertion-B header comment, 'recorded 7-line allowlist') and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:54 (ASCII layer-diagram edge label '-- 7 lines --'). The report also cited ORGANISATION.md:52/:219 where the live lines are :53/:220, and did not reach ORGANISATION.md:73-78, a dated counterfactual snapshot table whose '7' cells needed an explicit leave-unchanged decision. Cause: the report's sweep patterns were 'seven|7 line|7 recorded|upward', which miss a bare-word 7 and the hyphenated 7-line form. Folded into the plan as Phase 1 inventory additions plus a Decisions entry.

The dispatch's STANDING INSTRUCTION to re-verify before citing paid off directly: a single broad grep sweep over the four in-scope files during planning caught two missed live count sites and three line-number drifts before any edit was authored, converting what would have been a Phase-2 acceptance failure into a Phase-1 inventory item at zero cost.

Plan's line-number inventory for all 19 count-bearing edits across the 4 in-scope files matched the file state exactly on re-grep; zero deviations from plan across both phases; both check-metalogic-cycles.sh and check-module-invariants.sh --no-build went green on the first edit pass with no rework.
